name: Hilkiah
summary: The high priest in the days of King Josiah. While the temple was being repaired, he discovered the book of the law inside the LORD's house.

key_moments.title: Finds the Book of the Law
key_moments.description: King Josiah sent his scribe to Hilkiah to count the money for repairing the temple. Hilkiah told Shaphan he had discovered the book of the law inside the LORD's house, and gave it to him to read.

key_moments.title: Asking Huldah
key_moments.description: When the king heard the book read, he sent Hilkiah and others to ask the LORD about it. They went to Huldah the prophetess, who lived in Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Clears Baal's Vessels from the Temple
key_moments.description: The king had Hilkiah and the priests bring from the temple every vessel made for Baal or other false worship. They were burned in the Kidron fields outside Jerusalem.
